data_path.description: Path to the data directory for poezio

config_dir.description: Path to the configuration directory for poezio

check_updates.description: Enable or disable automatic update checks

term.description: Terminal type string to ensure correct 256-color support

debug_file.description: Path to a file for debug logging. Empty string disables file logging.

show_roster.description: Whether to display the roster tab by default

show_offline.description: Whether to display offline contacts in the roster

theme.description: Name of the UI theme to apply

show_status_bar.description: Whether to show the status bar at the bottom

accounts.description: List of XMPP accounts to configure automatically on login. Items is a flat map of account settings. Item ID is used to generate the section name [account:<id>]. Autojoin is a list of JIDs joined by comma in the config file. Priority is an integer 0-255. Status_type is one of available, busy, away, xa, offline.
